home.intro: Follow the missionary journeys across the ancient Mediterranean — every place, date and claim is cited, and contested points are shown as such.

sourcing.title: How we source
sourcing.body: Dates are shown as scholarly ranges, not single years. Each claim carries citations and a confidence level. Wikipedia is only ever an orienting link — never the sole authority: every claim is also backed by a concrete source (a primary text, a standard scholarly work, an excavation report, or a historical-geography reference), and the content build blocks any claim that rests on Wikipedia alone. Where scholars or traditions disagree, we say so. Bible text is public domain (World English Bible, King James Version). This atlas is carefully cited and reviewed — it does not claim to be definitive.

confidence.medium: Traditional or topographically apt, not proven
